app.noCardsTitle: Your expedition starts with a card
app.noCardsHint: Add your first card and start tracking purchases and installments month by month.

thankYou.body: Signing up for this beta means a lot to me. Thanks for trusting me and being part of this adventure from day one. 🚀

welcome.title: Welcome to ccExpedition!
welcome.body: Here is a quick tour of tracking expenses, monthly payments, budget alerts, and advances across all your cards.

cardList.title: Your cards
cardList.body: Pick All Cards for the consolidated view, or a single card to see its expenses in detail.

consolidated.title: Budget alert
consolidated.body: Set a monthly cap and months that exceed it are highlighted in the grid. In Profile you can change the alert currency and color.

table.title: Installments by month
table.body: The grid shows what you owe on each card per month. Click a cell for expense details, advances, and pending balances.

paidRow.title: Paid row
paidRow.body: Mark each card as paid per month. When all cards are paid, a celebration appears in the cell.

payments.title: Payments and pending balance
payments.body: If you only paid part of the total, the remainder carries over to the next month. Months before the current one are marked paid automatically.

exportCsv.title: Export CSV
exportCsv.body: In Profile → Data you'll be able to download all your expenses as a CSV for Excel or Google Sheets.

import.title: Import Excel
import.body: In each card view, upload your monthly bank statement (.xlsx) to add expenses automatically.

addCard.title: Add card
addCard.body: Create a card with a name, holder, and color to organize your spending.

language.title: Language
language.body: Switch between Spanish and English with ES / EN. You can also set the language in Profile.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: In Profile you can customize the app, manage cards, and replay tutorials.

profile.title: Profile
profile.body: From Profile you customize colors, cards, language, account, and replay any tutorial.

monthBar.title: Months
monthBar.body: Browse months to see which expenses hit in each billing period. It opens on next month by default.

addExpense.title: Add expense
addExpense.body: Add installment purchases, one-time charges, or subscriptions. Edit any expense with the pencil icon.

addAdjustment.title: Advance / credit balance
addAdjustment.body: Record an advance payment or credit balance that subtracts from that card's monthly total.

balanceAdjustment.title: Advances and credits
balanceAdjustment.body: Advances and credit balances appear in green in the month detail and in the consolidated grid when you click a cell.

cardDetail.title: Card view
cardDetail.body: Select a card above to see its expenses by month, import the bank Excel file, edit purchases, and record advances.

empty.title: Start here
empty.body: Add your first card to start tracking expenses.

welcome.title: Consolidated view
welcome.body: Here you see all your cards in one grid. Let's walk through this view's features.

nextCard.title: Card detail
nextCard.body: Tap a card above to see its expenses month by month, import the bank Excel file, and record advances.

welcome.title: Card view
welcome.body: Here you see one card's expenses month by month. Let's walk through the main features.

monthBar.title: Month bar
monthBar.body: Pick a month to see installments, advances, and pending balances. Each month's total appears below.

import.title: Import Excel
import.body: Upload your monthly bank statement (.xlsx) to add expenses automatically.

addExpense.title: Add expense
addExpense.body: Manually add installment purchases, one-time charges, or subscriptions.

addAdjustment.title: Advance / credit balance
addAdjustment.body: Record an advance payment or credit balance that subtracts from that month's total.

expenseList.title: Month list
expenseList.body: Each expense shows its installment, amounts, and start month. Advances appear in green.

edit.title: Edit and delete
edit.body: Use the pencil icon to edit an expense or advance, or × to remove it.

landing.heroFootnote: Sign up free with your email. The trial beta closes on July 9, 2026—early sign-ups get benefits. We don't access the data you enter in your sheets—your privacy comes first.

guilt.title: Does spending make you feel guilty?
guilt.subtitle: Us too.
guilt.bodyLine1: That's why we built a tool to speculate
guilt.bodyLine2: on future scenarios before pulling out your card.
guilt.bodyLine3: Because sometimes you need a brake.
guilt.bodyLine4: And sometimes you need someone to tell you:
guilt.quote: “Go ahead, buy it. You deserve it.”

step3.title: Travel to the future
step3.description: See how your upcoming statements look.

step4.title: You decide if you're a genius or a magician.

budgetPreview.title: Expedition detected difficult terrain
budgetPreview.description: Set a total monthly amount. If your projections go through the roof, months that exceed the limit turn red.
